description: This file defines an interface for content decryption and a DataExchange class for handling encrypted media data, including methods for managing initialization, session info, and media properties within a content decryption module.

classes.name: DataExchange
classes.description: A class for managing encrypted media data exchange, including setting IVs, encryption schemes, subsamples, and media properties.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets subsample, IV, key ID, and media properties to zero.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Sets or gets the status of the data exchange.

methods.name: InitWithLast15
methods.description: Sets or checks if initialization uses the last 15 bytes.

methods.name: SetEncPattern
methods.description: Sets the encryption pattern with encrypted and clear block counts.

methods.name: SubSamples
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the subsample information.

methods.name: SetMediaProperties
methods.description: Sets media stream properties: height, width, and type.

methods.name: IVKeyLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the IV key.
